title: Exo-Gargantua: a resolver for orbital period aliases in TESS light curves

creators.name: Banerjee, Srijeet Prasad
creators.affiliation: Guru Nanak Institute of Technology, Kolkata, India

description: Period alias resolver for TESS transit and eclipse signals, with the eclipsing binary benchmark (B5) and its preregistered replication (B6), the injection (B1), TOI holdout (B2), false alarm and run time (B4) benchmarks, the scripts that generate every number, table and figure of the accompanying AJ manuscript, and the released per target tables.
